content:
First-run data policy URL

Oasis points first-run / data reporting URLs at Kahana’s privacy policy section for personal data collection (distinct from Mozilla’s default URLs).

What this is

Oasis points first-run / data policy URLs at Kahana’s privacy documentation (including personal data collection) instead of Mozilla’s default pages, so expectations match the Oasis operator.

How to use it

  • Read the linked policy during first run.
  • Use Kahana support if wording conflicts with your enterprise contract.
  • Firefox engine security updates still come from Mozilla infrastructure.

Notes and limits

Regional translations may lag English policy text briefly after updates.
